reasoning: The agent coded the entire S3/SigV4 surface from memory with no upfront contract inventory, discovering gaps (credential parsing, canonical-request formatting) only when boto3 tests failed — squarely anchor-3 behavior. It rises above pure guessing because it did capture real boto3 signed requests and diff its canonical request against ground truth to resolve the canonicalization bug (a technique from anchors 8-10), but this was reactive, narrow to SigV4, and never generalized into systematic research of the broader contract, so it falls short of anchor 5's 'research the core hard parts before implementing.'
